challenges.name: First Clean Signal
challenges.predicateText: Finish C01 with no meaningful wall impacts and no reset.

challenges.name: One Deliberate Stop
challenges.predicateText: On T00 braking lane, stop from 100 km/h inside the marked 8 m target box, three distinct starts in one lesson; server verifies speed before each start.

challenges.name: Apex Appointment
challenges.predicateText: Finish C03 crossing all three designated apex gates without a wall incident.

challenges.name: The Exit Matters
challenges.predicateText: Finish C02 with three specified uphill exit gates crossed above their published Bronze reference speeds.

challenges.name: No Recovery Needed
challenges.predicateText: Finish C04 without reset, wrong-way warning, or leaving the legal corridor.

challenges.name: Cedar Accuracy
challenges.predicateText: Finish C05 touching all six alternating precision gates without touching a guardrail.

challenges.name: One Release
challenges.predicateText: In the fixed T00 loaner braking lesson, pass the trail-brake trace envelope through the test bend; no handbrake, valid lesson finish.

challenges.name: Wet Window
challenges.predicateText: Finish C08 with the two judged wet braking zones completed within the displayed speed/position envelopes and no wall incident.

challenges.name: Bridge Margin
challenges.predicateText: Finish C13 crossing both viaduct lane gates while staying at least the published 0.5 m safety margin from barriers in those zones.

challenges.name: Equal Splits
challenges.predicateText: Complete C11's two laps with lap-time difference <=2.0 seconds, both legal and within Silver reference time.

challenges.name: Blackwater Needle
challenges.predicateText: In the supplied class-capped C12 challenge loaner, beat its Gold reference with no reset and at most one meaningful wall impact.

challenges.name: The Last Ten Metres
challenges.predicateText: Finish C20, passing all four late-braking target gates within their published speed windows; no collision/reset in those sectors.

challenges.name: Narrow Without Fear
challenges.predicateText: Beat the fixed C21 Gold ghost while keeping all tyres in the paved corridor; a normal shoulder touch invalidates this challenge, not the entire race.

challenges.name: Unbroken Datum
challenges.predicateText: Finish a C17/C18/C19 three-event challenge cup with zero meaningful wall impacts across all legs; individual stage resets cannot carry progress.

challenges.name: Dawn Precision
challenges.predicateText: Beat C25's fixed challenge reference with all final-sector apex gates and no reset.

challenges.name: First Arc
challenges.predicateText: Bank a single legal 8,000-point raw chain in T00's guided drift route and complete the lesson.

challenges.name: Change of Direction
challenges.predicateText: Link three distinct left-right judged corners on C03 without losing the unbanked chain, then finish.

challenges.name: Settle and Go
challenges.predicateText: On C04 bank two separate raw drift chains, each >=6,000; return below 8 degrees slip for 2 seconds between them; finish.

challenges.name: A Useful Angle
challenges.predicateText: Hold a legal 20–35 degree drift for at least 3 seconds in the C05 demonstration zone and finish.

challenges.name: No Doughnuts
challenges.predicateText: Score 25,000 raw in C01 drift variant using forward judged zones with no repeated-progress scoring, then finish.

challenges.name: Rain Thread
challenges.predicateText: Score 70,000 raw on C08 wet Drift Attack, with at least two banked chains and a legal finish.

challenges.name: Outer Clip Reader
challenges.predicateText: On C09 connect its three marked outer clip zones within one valid chain, without wall contact, then finish.

challenges.name: Countersteer Conversation
challenges.predicateText: Complete T00 advanced countersteer drill with four alternating valid recoveries into the next arc and no spin/reset.

challenges.name: A Long Sentence
challenges.predicateText: Bank one >=60,000 raw chain on C15 without slowing below 45 km/h during the scoring portion; finish.

challenges.name: Both Hands Light
challenges.predicateText: In the fixed C16 drift loaner, score its Silver target without using handbrake after the start gate; finish.

challenges.name: Needle in the Rain
challenges.predicateText: Beat the fixed wet C12 Gold drift reference and finish with no meaningful wall impact.

challenges.name: Six Connected Corners
challenges.predicateText: Link all six unique C19 judged transition zones in one forward chain and bank it at the final gate; finish.

challenges.name: One Car, Two Languages
challenges.predicateText: In a fixed C23 challenge build, beat both its published time and raw drift targets in the same legal run.

challenges.name: No Wasted Motion
challenges.predicateText: Bank the C24 Gold raw target with total unbanked points lost <=5% of earned raw points, no reset, and a legal finish.

challenges.name: Dawn Ribbon
challenges.predicateText: Complete the dedicated C25 Gold drift route in its loaner, scoring the published raw target and banking a valid chain in every judged sector.

challenges.name: Clean Pass
challenges.predicateText: Pass one live AI or human in an eligible six-slot race without contact within 2 seconds before/after the pass; retain position for 3 seconds and finish.

challenges.name: Patient Mirror
challenges.predicateText: Follow an eligible moving AI or human within the displayed 1–2 second gap for 8 seconds on C05 without contact, then finish.

challenges.name: Start in Control
challenges.predicateText: In an eligible race, complete the first sector without false-start input penalty, wall impact, or off-course excursion; finish.

challenges.name: Let the Corner End
challenges.predicateText: Pass a rival on the exit zone of C02's marked hairpin, not its approach, retain the gain to the next gate, then finish.

challenges.name: Graceful Return
challenges.predicateText: Use one permitted reset in a race, then finish the remainder with no meaningful wall impact and all checkpoints legal.

challenges.name: Outside Invitation
challenges.predicateText: In a fixed C10 racecraft trial, pass its pacing rival using the outside lane gate and hold the gain through the next straight; finish.

challenges.name: Keep the Door Open
challenges.predicateText: Complete the scripted T00 merge lesson beside an AI pace car with both cars inside their legal lanes and no contact for the entire merge.

challenges.name: Three Different Rivals
challenges.predicateText: Win three eligible Freeplay races against three different authored lead-AI archetypes, with no race quit between these wins; losses do not erase completed archetypes.

challenges.name: No Panic Reply
challenges.predicateText: In the C14 pressure trial, maintain a valid Silver pace while its AI pressure car follows within 1 second for one sector; finish without wall contact in that sector.

challenges.name: Late, Not Dirty
challenges.predicateText: Perform the marked clean braking-zone overtake in C17's fixed challenge race, no contact and no checkpoint cut, then finish.

challenges.name: From Sixth
challenges.predicateText: Win a class-equalized C18 six-entrant challenge race from the last grid position, with no reset and no car-to-car contact. AI fills all missing human slots.

challenges.name: Four Roads Ahead
challenges.predicateText: Complete a fixed C06/C13/C21 three-event cup ahead of its designated benchmark in every leg; valid finish each time, no need for another human.

challenges.name: Leave No Opening
challenges.predicateText: Beat R32's C20 Gold practice reference while completing both marked defence/exit gates within the legal corridor; no blocking/contact requirement.

challenges.name: Read the Surveyor
challenges.predicateText: Clear the Normal S30 finale personally within the qualifying benchmark, not only the support envelope.

challenges.name: Answer the Quiet
challenges.predicateText: Clear the Hard S30 finale personally within Shiori's qualifying benchmark, not only the support envelope.

challenges.name: Your First Setup
challenges.predicateText: Save a legal personalized tune preset with a changed final drive and complete T00's acceleration lane with it; loaner tools are free.

challenges.name: Before and After
challenges.predicateText: Use the garage comparison harness on stock and a loaned tyre package, inspect the measured braking difference, then finish its braking lesson.

challenges.name: Sign Your Car
challenges.predicateText: Apply and save a legal livery with one owned/free decal and two paint regions; verify it appears on the meet display car.

challenges.name: A Place for Every Gear
challenges.predicateText: Complete the guided gearing lesson at its target shift windows using a supplied car; no purchase required.

challenges.name: Change Without Losing
challenges.predicateText: Create two visual presets, switch between them and restore the first exactly; confirm its saved server revision and meet preview.

challenges.name: Rain Has a Setup
challenges.predicateText: Complete the fixed C08 challenge using the supplied wet tune, beating its Silver benchmark; ownership of parts not required.

challenges.name: Weight Is Not Free
challenges.predicateText: Finish both T00 handling comparison routes in supplied light/heavy tune variants within their separate reference envelopes.

challenges.name: Differential Diagnosis
challenges.predicateText: Complete the guided C03 two-corner challenge in both supplied diff setups, with each passing its declared turn-in/exit criteria.

challenges.name: One Index, Two Cars
challenges.predicateText: Beat Silver reference targets on C09 in two different equalized loaner drive layouts; same PI cap, separate fair target times.

challenges.name: No Power Purchase
challenges.predicateText: Beat the supplied stock V01 Silver reference on C04 without performance upgrades; cosmetics allowed.

challenges.name: A Tune for the Hill
challenges.predicateText: Using free challenge tuning parts within a locked PI budget, beat C23 Gold reference; server validates all installed parameters.

challenges.name: Balanced, Not Maximum
challenges.predicateText: Beat C15's fixed Gold combined grip/exit target with its tune-budget loaner; neither front nor rear aero may be at the range maximum.

challenges.name: Three Layouts, One Driver
challenges.predicateText: Complete Gold short reference trials in the supplied FWD, RWD and AWD cars on three named T00 configurations; no ownership requirement.

challenges.name: Build Under Pressure
challenges.predicateText: Win the scripted C19 six-slot equal-PI AI challenge using any legal self-authored loaner tune within the provided parts budget.

challenges.name: The Complete Notebook
challenges.predicateText: Complete the 10 named advanced tuning demonstrations and their driving checks; they cover distinct systems, not ten copies of one slider task.

challenges.name: First Parking Place
challenges.predicateText: Enter Cedar Lantern Terrace, complete or skip the arrival presentation, leave the car and inspect your own parked vehicle.

challenges.name: Four Corners of the Terrace
challenges.predicateText: Walk to the four marked meet viewpoints without leaving scene bounds; inspect each location placard.

challenges.name: A Driver's Greeting
challenges.predicateText: Use wave and bow at the tutorial meet host NPC, then inspect the emote help. No other human is required.

challenges.name: A Picture With a Horizon
challenges.predicateText: Take an in-game photo at the terrace overlook with the horizon marker and own car in frame; use the built-in composition check.

challenges.name: Bring It Home
challenges.predicateText: Complete any eligible event, return to a meet and inspect the result slip at the timing board.

challenges.name: Six Places, Not Six Skies
challenges.predicateText: Finish one legal course in each of the six regular regions; variants do not create extra regions.

challenges.name: The Working Landscape
challenges.predicateText: Discover and inspect the three named non-race photo points in the terrace scene: tea kiosk, radio bench, maintenance gate.

challenges.name: Chasing Your Yesterday
challenges.predicateText: Record a valid C07 personal ghost, then beat it by at least 1 second in a compatible ruleset; a reset-created artificially slow ghost does not qualify.

challenges.name: A Quiet Cup
challenges.predicateText: Complete the noncompetitive C01/C05/C09 touring cup within its generous legal time limits, with no quit; photo stops occur only after finishes.

challenges.name: The Other Side of the Card
challenges.predicateText: Read the six crew introductions in the race diary after encountering each crew, then complete one legal race against any crew member.

challenges.name: Every Real Road
challenges.predicateText: Legally finish T00's loop and all C01–C25 courses in any eligible normal/practice event; track IDs, not variants.

challenges.name: Before the First Train
challenges.predicateText: Finish the fixed pre-dawn C21/C22/C23 touring challenge cup without a reset, meeting each generous Silver pace; one continuous cup session.

challenges.name: Twelve Different Voices
challenges.predicateText: Complete legal races against 12 distinct rival driving archetype demonstrations in Freeplay; use named loaner trials for any rare style, not random luck.

challenges.name: The Radio Remembered
challenges.predicateText: Collect the six authored radio/timing-slip story records through Normal progression, then win the C24 post-story reference trial.

challenges.name: After the Last Signal
challenges.predicateText: Complete Hard S30, return to the terrace alone or with friends, and finish the final short story epilogue with Shiori at the radio bench.
